get.description: SSE event names: run_queued, run_started, run_progress, run_output, run_completed, run_failed, run_cancelled, run_unknown_submission, backend_health_changed, settings_changed; resync terminates the stream. Pass bus_id with the replay cursor to detect server restarts even when the numeric ID is still in range. Ordinary data uses the EventEnvelope schema; resync data uses the ResyncEvent schema (see components/schemas). Connected and heartbeat frames are comments.
